verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a general REST API, double-entry bookkeeping, and a way to invite a tax advisor into the account. None of the evidence shows an API endpoint for creating or posting journal entries, or a draft or review-queue state for an accountant to approve. Generic API access and advisor collaboration are adjacent features, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
